Incorporation

Problem: A microbrewery was still operating as a sole proprietor at high personal tax rates with a valuable brand and equipment exposed.

Solution: We incorporated the brewery, used a section 85 rollover to move the equipment and brand in tax-deferred, and set up a clean share structure.
